title: Nine Medals of Courage
subtitle: 胸膛与胸怀 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 胸膛与胸怀（生活与学习·健康医疗）
meta: 主题语境：胸膛与胸怀（生活与学习·健康医疗）　|　核心词汇：breast　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 breast 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my mother was sent to bind ① a breast she could not look at, and she said the looking was the whole of the lesson. The ② breast, meaning the chest and not the heart, was nine inches wide and was bandaged by whoever came last; a breast, she said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ breast in that portrait had the same medal, and the ④ breast at the front, meaning the one the colonel wore and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever painted properly. A breast, my grandmother said, is nine parts linen and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the linen is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ breast was the whole of the courage, meaning the heart it held and not the chest. The ⑥ breast, meaning the courage and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody praises and nobody questions; a breast, he said, is either something you bind or the only word that means both a chest and a courage. She said the courage is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ breast had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the linen. The ⑧ breast of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine inches of linen and eleven years of binding; a breast, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ breast I remember is the one at the front, which was painted in 1977 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ breast, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being given; every breast, she said, is a courage that has agreed to look like a chest. She said the courage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 胸膛（指躯体那一部分，与心相对）
C. 固定搭配：bind a breast 包扎胸部
D. n. 胸前（指画像里每一处）
E. n. 胸前（指前面那一处）
F. n. 胸怀；勇气（抽象：与躯体相对）
G. n. 那份勇气（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a breast she could not look at
The breast, meaning the chest and not the heart
breast was the whole of the courage
the breast had become a photograph in a report
The breast of the whole thing
A breast, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: bind a breast 意为“包扎胸部”，1954 年母亲被派去包扎一處她不敢看的胸部伤口。
breast 意为“胸膛”，指躯体那一部分而不是心，宽九英寸，由最后走的人包扎。
breast 指画像里每一处胸前，每一处都挂着同样的勋章。
breast 指前面那一处（上校佩戴的那一处），是唯一有人认真画过的。
breast 意为“胸怀、勇气”，与躯体相对，父亲说 breast 就是那份勇气的全部。
breast 为抽象用法，指那份勇气本身，是一家人里人人都称赞、却没人质疑的东西。
breast 意为“胸部、胸膛”，到 1972 年这处 breast 成了报告里的一张照片。
breast 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英寸的绷带和十一年的包扎。
breast 意为“胸前”，我记得的是前面那一处，1977 年被画下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
breast 为抽象总称，祖母说胸怀是唯一会因为被付出而变好的东西。
